entries.06abe8192d37b87e: It is a company visit app. Placing importance on matching based on vision and values, it supports the early stages of recruitment activities. For companies, it provides a subscription-based recruitment service through which they can use job postings, article submissions, sending and receiving messages with candidates, and scouting (direct recruiting), and it also provides optional services such as advertising and content creation. This is a service closely related to revenue generation. There is no separate disclosure of amounts.

entries.5ebd56fbf57a0985: Under the mission 'Increasing the number of people whose hearts leap at work through the ultimate matching of the right person to the right place,' it operates the business SNS 'Wantedly' as a platform for all business professionals. Aiming to enhance medium- to long-term corporate value, it intends to actively promote 'Engagement Suite' and 'Wantedly Hire,' a new business area, while continuing to develop and improve its core product 'Wantedly Visit.' As priorities, it cites strengthening the value offered by the Visit business through improvements such as to its recommendation algorithm, and accelerating investment in new business areas, and it states a policy of investing revenue from 'Wantedly Visit' in 'Engagement Suite' and 'Wantedly Hire' to develop them into businesses that drive growth over the medium to long term. As issues to be addressed, it cites expanding revenue opportunities through the use of AI, ensuring system stability, strengthening its business organizational structure, strengthening its information management structure, and raising awareness of its services.

entries.b951f8faaf41c39e: This is a single-segment business operating Wantedly, a business SNS for all business professionals. By creating and expanding business connections from perspectives that conventional mechanisms have overlooked, such as vision, individuality and values, it supports individuals' careers from meeting others through to settling in and performing well. As of the end of August 2025, the domestic service had 4.32 million individual users and 43,000 corporate users. Operating revenue for the fiscal year ended August 2025 was ¥4,908 million.
entries.c76e53468da8bc6c: It is a next-generation recruitment management system (ATS). It supports centralized management and streamlining of the entire selection process from application to job offer, and provides functions such as automatic scheduling, flexible process design, and advanced data analysis. This is a service in a new business area, released in November 2024. There is no separate disclosure of amounts.
entries.d8d383db501d83bb: Its feature is a mechanism that matches individuals with companies based on empathy with a company's vision and values, rather than on conditions such as salary and benefits.
entries.e0439990282c79eb: Its feature is a mechanism that matches individuals with companies based on empathy with a company's vision and values, rather than on conditions such as salary and benefits. The structure is such that when employees and individual users share job postings and articles published by companies on social media, it leads to new individual user registrations and the opening of company accounts. Fees are subscription-based, premised on continuous service provision, and because the service is used by many customers at relatively low unit prices, the share of total revenue accounted for by the top 10 customers is 10% or less, so dependence on specific customers is small.

It consists of the online internal newsletter service 'Story', which helps members share purpose and a sense of unity; the team management service 'Pulse', which supports understanding and improvement of the current state of team members; and the employee benefits service 'Perk', which supports realization of optimal welfare benefits for companies. There is no separate disclosure of amounts.
